{{Top|leg|canon=Riftwalker sabacc}}
'''Riftwalker''' was a variant of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] popular local to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valnoos/Legends|Valnoos]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once played Riftwalker with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mirta Gev]] in the [[Blue Star]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]].<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
